final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM scanqc sq JOIN projects p ON sq.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) as total FROM grouped), paired AS (SELECT g.fundflux, g.record_count, t.total, CAST(g.record_count AS FLOAT) / t.total as ratio FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN total_count t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(record_count AS FLOAT)) as avg_rec FROM paired WHERE record_count IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.fundflux, p.record_count, p.ratio, CAST(p.record_count AS FLOAT) / a.avg_rec as ratio_to_avg FROM paired p CROSS JOIN avg_count a WHERE a.avg_rec IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.fundflux
